Compare Two Computational Environment Snapshots

Source: R/repro_environment.R
compare_environments.Rd

Diffs two environment snapshots from capture_environment() and reports what changed between them: whether the R version, platform, operating system, or locale differ, and which packages were added, removed, or changed version. This is how a reviewer, or the sponsor before submission, checks that a reproduction environment matches the one that produced the submitted results, and pinpoints the exact software differences when results diverge.

Usage

compare_environments(x, y, labels = c("x", "y"))

Arguments

x, y

Two environments to compare, each either a repro_environment object from capture_environment() or a path to a snapshot JSON file written by it. x is the baseline and y the comparison.

labels

Optional character vector of two short names for x and y used in the printed output and the version columns. Defaults to c("x", "y").

Value

An object of class repro_environment_diff: a list with r_version_changed, platform_changed, os_changed, and locale_changed (logical flags), each accompanied by *_x and *_y values; a packages tibble with one row per package across both snapshots (columns package, status - one of "unchanged", "added", "removed", "version_changed" - version_x, and version_y); the counts n_unchanged, n_added, n_removed, n_changed; labels; and identical (TRUE when the R version and every package match, regardless of platform, OS, or locale). It has a print method.

Details

The comparison is directional: x is the baseline (for example the recorded submission environment) and y is the comparison (for example the reviewer's reproduction environment). A package present in y but not x is "added"; one present in x but not y is "removed"; one present in both with a different version is "version_changed".

This is a descriptive/integrity helper, not an indicator. It emits no R4SUB evidence and does not change the pass/fail or score of any indicator. It reports the differences mechanically and applies no threshold or judgement about whether a given change matters.

See also

capture_environment() to capture a snapshot.

Examples

# Two synthetic snapshots (a reproducer would pass real captures)
si1 <- list(
  R.version = list(version.string = "R version 4.4.1 (2024-06-14)"),
  platform  = "x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64",
  otherPkgs = list(dplyr = list(Package = "dplyr", Version = "1.1.4")))
si2 <- list(
  R.version = list(version.string = "R version 4.5.1 (2025-06-13)"),
  platform  = "x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64",
  otherPkgs = list(dplyr = list(Package = "dplyr", Version = "1.1.5")))
d <- compare_environments(capture_environment(si1), capture_environment(si2))
d$r_version_changed
#> [1] TRUE
d$packages
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   package status          version_x version_y
#>   <chr>   <chr>           <chr>     <chr>    
#> 1 dplyr   version_changed 1.1.4     1.1.5
